purchase_by.description: Who performed the purchase behind evidence purchase. verifier: the verifier paid for and received the resource itself. relayed: the verifier holds a record of another party's paid call, named in purchase_source. Appears only with evidence purchase.

purchase_source.description: The source of a relayed purchase. A relayed purchase reaches evidence purchase only if a client can check record_url offline, as a signature over the record's bytes against a key bound to source_domain, without calling the source and without trusting the relaying verifier.

record_url.description: The source's signed record of the paid call.

key_url.description: Where the source publishes its signing key, under source_domain.

key_id.description: Names the signing key when key_url serves more than one.

method_digest.description: Digest of the method document this verdict was produced under, as <algorithm>:<lowercase hex> over the document's bytes as served, for example sha256:<64 hex>.

detail.description: Companion to reason for codes that reference a specific mismatched field. field is always required when detail is present.

accepts_index.description: Index into the challenge's accepts array that this verdict, digest, and mapping apply to. Always present; a single-accept challenge carries 0.

attestation.description: A signed record making the independence claim below checkable. subject names the two identities being compared; a client discounts the attestation if verifier_domain is not distinct from resource_domain, or if key_url/record_url do not resolve under verifier_domain.

key_url.description: Where the verifier publishes its signing key, under verifier_domain.

record_url.description: The specific signed record for this verdict, under verifier_domain.

relationship.description: The verifier's declared commercial interest in this verdict, from a closed, append-only set. A disclosure, not evidence of independence. An absent value is read as undisclosed. none and undisclosed each stand alone.
